facts.text: Eaten out of the boxes on the desk
facts.why: The script and Wikipedia plot show the crew at the firehouse but no Chinese takeaway or boxes on the desk, so the scene is unproven. The note can describe how the dish is served instead.
facts.fix: Served out of takeaway boxes, firehouse style

vibe.verdict: A fun work order that nails the firehouse and Slimer, but it skips the film's best quotes and props.
missing: Don't cross the streams (Egon in the hotel lift)
Dana's eggs cooking on the counter (the first scare)
'We came, we saw, we kicked its ass' (the hotel ballroom)
Zuul and the Keymaster (Dana and Louis)
ideas: Swap 'Firehouse Chinese' for 'Egon's Twinkie', with 'Don't cross the streams' skewers.
Swap 'Marshmallow skewers' note for 'Cross two of them and it is bad'.
Add 'Important safety tip. Thanks, Egon.' to the field notes in place of 'Long enough for the whole crew'.
Swap 'No job too spooky' for 'We came, we saw, we kicked its ass' on the bottom strip.
changed: Marshmallow skewers note: don't cross the streams
